definition: [ תִּגְרָה ] noun feminine contention, strife, hostility (compare Aramaic תִּגְרָא , often ᵑ7 ; see Thes ; תִּגְרָה NHWB & Fl in ChWB ii. 581 ) — only construct singular מִתִּגְרַת יָָֽדְךָ Ps 39:11 from (i.e. through ) the hostility of thy hand I am consumed . I. גֵּרָה II. גֵּרָה see below גרר . גֵּרוּת see below I. גור .
